traps.why: You handed over the carboxylate / phenoxide salt. H₃O⁺ protonates both oxygens to give the free acid.
Kolbe–Schmitt carboxylates ORTHO to the phenoxide oxygen (the sodium ion holds CO₂ next to it), not para.

explanation: NaOH makes the phenoxide; CO₂ under pressure is attacked ortho to the O⁻ (the Na⁺ directs it); H₃O⁺ gives the 2-hydroxybenzoic acid.
tip: Kolbe–Schmitt = COOH ortho to OH. Three steps, don't skip the acid.
